facts.text: The environment is registered under the id molecule-v0 with entry point gym_molecule.envs:MoleculeEnvironment
The constructor starts the current molecule as carbon, Chem.MolFromSmiles('C')
step adds action_ob.mol at the front or the back of molecule_list when action_c is Add
step removes the first or the last molecule_list element when action_c is Remove
step rebuilds current_molecule from listToSmiles, updates obs and returns only self.obs: no reward, terminated or truncated value
reset sets current_molecule to carbon and returns nothing
seed takes a SMILES string and sets current_molecule and molecule_list from it
listToSmiles concatenates every molecule_list entry into one SMILES string
render returns a grid image of mol_Steps drawn with Draw.MolsToGridImage
Action.setAction stores action_c, mol (default 'C') and pos
Observation.getObservation returns Chem.MolToSmiles of its molecule
The README describes the project as a reinforcement learning environment for inverse drug design
The README names step, reset, render, seed and close as the essential methods
The test constructs MoleculeEnvironment and asserts that it is a gym.Env
environment.yml lists Python 3.7.7 with gym and rdkit

determinism.notes: the list edits are deterministic, but the upstream exposes no integer seed (its seed() takes a SMILES string) and no get_state/set_state, so this package makes no replay claim

gaps: no dynamics: each transition adds or removes a SMILES fragment in molecule_list; there is no physics, no time step and no continuous state

the fake backend replaces RDKit's MolFromSmiles/MolToSmiles with plain SMILES string concatenation; it does not parse, validate or canonicalise a molecule, and it was not compared with the upstream environment
the upstream defines no action_space or observation_space, returns an Observation object from step and None from reset, and has no reward, terminated, truncated or info values
no seed control: the upstream seed(Smiles) selects a start molecule and is not an integer RNG seed, so cap.world.seed.v1 is not bound
rendering is not served: render() returns a PIL image and cap.world.render.v1 needs an artifact store
snapshot and restore are not offered: the environment exposes no get_state/set_state
no physical device is modelled and the model was never validated against one
